test_title: SSC Stenographer 2023 Official Paper (Held On: 13 Oct, 2023 Shift 2)
subject: general
question: Select the most appropriate title for the passage.
solution:
The correct answer is:** 'More Freedom For Greater Responsibility'.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The most appropriate title for the passage is:** 'More Freedom For Greater Responsibility'.**
 
• As this is clearly mentioned in the passage: **'We ought to be given the opportunity to learn from our mistakes and accept responsibility for them rather than being held accountable for them'.**

Therefore, the correct answer is: **'Option 1'.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **'****Parents and Adults'** is not the appropriate title of the passage.
 
• **'Teenage Problems' **is not the appropriate title of the passage.
 
• **'Youth and Learning' **is not the appropriate title of the passage.
